title: Interrupted history previews count already removed bytes
symptom: An interrupted-cycle preview overstates remaining reclaimable files and bytes
trigger: Publish a valid cycle removal receipt, remove one planned file, then preview resumed cleanup
expected: Preview reports only still-present candidate files and their measured bytes while preserving the original receipt plan separately
actual: Preview reported 847 bytes when the remaining file held 494 bytes in the controlled fixture
source: Current-source exact-byte assertion before the reporting fix

notes.text: status: open -> verified. The later full lane passes the exact remaining-byte assertion; current files/bytes and original receipt plan are reported separately.
